title: Explicit enlarged bar tower
statement: For the enlarged indexing diagram [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-index], label a source piece by its original stage and target block k by k. Define F_n as the bar total [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] of the full subdiagram on labels at most n. Stage inclusion gives u_n:F_n -> F_(n+1), source inclusion gives a_n:R_n -> F_n [def-sc-compact-flat-source-bar-tower], and the restricted augmented cocone gives q_n:F_n -> Cone(delta).

proof.text: Restrict the enlarged diagram by the stage-label subtype. The label need not be monotone on mixed arrows; the full-subdiagram restriction is sufficient. Define each tower map by reindexing and an identity transformation. Restrict the enlarged cocone and take its total augmentation. No witness of an unproved theorem defines these objects.
